armySpecialRules.name: SACRIFICIAL HUNT
armySpecialRules.description: All models with this special rule may re-roll the distance they pursue a broken enemy from combat.

armySpecialRules.name: GUERRILLA WARFARE
armySpecialRules.description: The following applies to models with this special rule:

armySpecialRules.name: Serpent's Strike
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule gain the Devastating Charge special rule. In any turn in which they successfully charge an enemy unit in the flank or rear, they may re- roll 1's To Hit and To Wound.

armySpecialRules.name: Predator's Feint
armySpecialRules.description:
In the first round of close combat in which a unit with this special rule does not win the combat or the enemy passes their Break test, it may choose to disengage from combat instead of taking a Break test or making a combat reform. Units affected by Frenzy cannot attempt to disengage from combat.
If the unit chooses to disengage, it makes a Flee move as if it had broken from combat. However, this does not cause Panic for breaking within 6" of friendly units. The enemy unit may only choose to pursue if they won the combat.
In addition, whenever a unit with this rule chooses Flee as a charge reaction or to disengage from combat, it gains +1 to its Flee distance.

armySpecialRules.name: Hunter's Step
armySpecialRules.description: Unless it charged, marched or fled during the Movement phase of its turn, a unit with the Fast Cavalry or Skirmishers special rules armed with missile weapons may move up to its Movement value directly backwards after resolving its missile attacks in its Shooting phase.

armySpecialRules.name: KOKA
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this upgrade gain the Frenzy special rule, and they do not lose Frenzy by losing a round of combat.

armySpecialRules.name: CLAW OF THE OLD ONES
armySpecialRules.description:
Claws of the Old Ones are hand weapons with the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | +1 | Armour Piercing (2), Magical Attacks

armySpecialRules.name: PAIRED CLAWS OF THE OLD ONES
armySpecialRules.description:
Paired Claws of the Old Ones have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | +1 | Armour Piercing (2), Magical Attacks, Requires Two Hands, Parry (6+)
A model with paired Claws of the Old Ones gains +1 Attack.

armySpecialRules.name: SUN GAUNTLET
armySpecialRules.description:
Sun Gauntlets have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
8/12" | 4 | Armour Piercing (2), Magical Attacks, Quick to Fire

armySpecialRules.name: SUNSTAFF
armySpecialRules.description:
Sunstaffs have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
18/24" | 4 | Armour Piercing (2), Magical Attacks, Quick to Fire

armySpecialRules.name: AMULET OF THE MOON
armySpecialRules.description: All missile and close combat attacks targeting a model with an Amulet of the Moon suffer -1 to Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: ENCHANTED CHARMS
armySpecialRules.description: A model with Enchanted Charms has the Magical Ward (6+) and Magic Resistance (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: STAR SWORD
magicItems.description: The Star Sword gives the wielder the Always Strikes First, Ignores Armour saves, and Parry (6+) special rules.

magicItems.name: ARC CLAWS
magicItems.description: Attacks made with the Arc Claws have the Lightning Attacks special rule, and the wielder may reroll any failed To Wound rolls in close combat.

magicItems.name: HAND OF RIGG
magicItems.description: All attacks made with the Hand of Rigg are resolved at Strength 8 and have the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: BRIGHT STAFF
magicItems.description: The Bright Staff has a range of 30" and the Multiple Shots (D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: JAGUAR MACE
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Armour Piercing (1) special rule, and enemies attacking the wielder in close combat suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: SKYPIERCER
magicItems.description: All shots from Skypiercer are resolved at Strength 5 with the Flaming Attacks special rule. Each shot penetrates ranks like a bolt thrower, but does not suffer any Strength penalties for each rank.

magicItems.name: METEOR SPEAR
magicItems.description: Attacks made with the Meteor Spear have the Flaming Attacks special rule. When charging, all attacks made with it have +1 Strength with the Armour Piercing (1) and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: ROAR OF CHOTEC
magicItems.description: Shots from the Roar of Chotec have Strength 6. When firing the Roar of Chotec, you may choose to overcharge it, making the shot have Strength 7 and the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule. If you do so, on a To Hit roll of 1 the wielder suffers one automatic hit from the weapon, using the normal profile, even if you can reroll the initial To Hit roll of 1.

magicItems.name: MOONBLADE
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Parry (6+) special rule. In addition, for every successful Parry save they make, the model that struck the blow suffers a Strength 4 Hit.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF FEATHER IRON
magicItems.description: All enemy units in base contact with the bearer are subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: CRYSTALLINE ARMOUR
magicItems.description: For every spell successfully cast upon the bearer or the unit they are with, the Amazon player gains an additional Power Dice or Dispel dice to their current pool.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE SWAMP DRAKE
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Aquatic and Natural Armour (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: MAGIC FEATHERS OF NATALINA
magicItems.description: Enemies must re-roll successful rolls To Hit in close combat and with missile weapons against the wearer. In addition, they gain a Magical Ward (6+).

magicItems.name: ASPECT OF AXLBERYN
magicItems.description: The wearer gains Ethereal special rules, but cannot join any units.

magicItems.name: SHIELD AMULET
magicItems.description: For every Wound the wearer suffers, roll a D6. If this number is equal to or higher than the Strength of the Attack, the Wound is nullified.

magicItems.name: SIGN OF POTEC
magicItems.description: The wearer has Magic Resistance (1) special rule. Additionally, models with the Daemonic, Undead and Vampiric special rules must reroll successful To Hit rolls made against the wearer in close combat.

magicItems.name: MIRAGE OF AMAXONIA
magicItems.description: The wearer gains Dodge (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: ITZL'S BEAST-WARD
magicItems.description: Any unit containing Warbeasts, Monstrous Beasts, Monsters, Cavalry, Monstrous Cavalry and Chariots that wants to declare a charge at the character bearing this amulet or their unit must first pass a Leadership test. If failed, the unit may choose a different target for their charge or to not make a charge.

magicItems.name: BRIGHT WAND OF XOLOC
magicItems.description: The Bright Wand of Xoloc contains a magic missile with a range of 24" that is resolved like a hit from a bolt thrower with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: LOCKET OF RIGG
magicItems.description: This item contains a random spell from the Lore of Light (Level 1-2). At the start of the game, roll a D6 to determine which spell the result correspond to – you may replace the rolled spell with Shem's Burning Gaze if you wish.

magicItems.name: THE COBRA STAFF
magicItems.description: The Cobra Staff contains a magic missile with a range of 18" that causes 2D6 hits. These hits always Wound on a 4+ with the Armour Piercing (2) special rule.

magicItems.name: TIARA OF SERENA
magicItems.description: The bearer may attempt to cast the same spell twice in each Magic phase if the first attempt was either unsuccessful or dispelled.

magicItems.name: ELIXIR OF LIFE
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Elixir of Life gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule, and automatically heals one Wound suffered earlier in the game at the start of each turn.

magicItems.name: FIERY WINGS
magicItems.description: The wearer has the Fly (10) and Impact Hits (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: PLAQUE OF THE OLD ONES
magicItems.description: The bearer becomes a Level 1 Wizard who can use any of the eight Winds of Magic from the Warhammer Rulebook. However, they do not get any bonus to casting or dispelling and cannot channel dice.

magicItems.name: BLUE STUMP BREW
magicItems.description: The brew may be drunk at any time. Roll a D6; this is the number of points the character may increase her characteristics by. She may freely divide them between several different characteristics if she wishes. The effects of the brew last until the start of the character’s next turn.

magicItems.name: EYE OF TZCALLI
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Sniper special rule.

magicItems.name: EMERALD OF THE MOON
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Armour Piercing (1) and Poisoned Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: AUGUR SKULL
magicItems.description: Enemy units deploying with the Scout special rule cannot be set up closer than 18" away from the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: DEATH WHISTLE
magicItems.description: Any enemy unit that is charged by the bearer of this item must take a Terror test.

magicItems.name: STATUE OF SOTEK
magicItems.description: All Skink units in base contact with the bearer are subject to the Always Strikes Last and Hatred special rules.

magicItems.name: WARRIOR'S SUN RING
magicItems.description: The bearer can reroll one failed To Wound roll in each of their combat phases.

magicItems.name: HUANCHI'S JAGUAR HEADDRESS
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Ambushers special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE FIRST QUEEN
magicItems.description: The range of the bearer’s Hold Your Ground special rule is increased by 6". Additionally, the bearer of this standard and any unit accompanying them has the Strider special rule and are Stubborn in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: JAGUAR STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Jaguar Standard gain the Strength Bonus (1) special rule and have the Cold-blooded special rule when taking Break Tests.

magicItems.name: EAGLE BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Swiftstride special rule and may reroll any 1's for their Charge distance roll.

magicItems.name: PIRANHA TOTEM
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: PENNANT OF SERENA
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard automatically passes Leadership tests to disengage from combat when using Guerrilla Warfare, and may choose to move normally in the Remaining Moves phase after rallying, even if they are not Skirmishers or Fast Cavalry.

magicItems.name: TAPESTRY OF INHAMEX
magicItems.description: If a friendly unit within 6" is destroyed or involuntarily flees, the unit carrying this standard may re-roll 1's when rolling To Hit and To Wound in their next close combat phase.
